script.spoken: Why 700 million people catch mosquito-borne illness yearly. Those infections kill over one million people a year. Yet there are about 3,600 mosquito species. Only a small share of them spread human disease. Mosquitoes have existed for at least 79 million years. Some fish and birds eat them, but few depend on them alone. So targeting the deadly few matters more than wiping out all.
